blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — How can academic research move beyond university campuses and contribute to addressing challenges faced by communities? This question was at the center of the 2nd Recoletos Graduate Research Congress (RGRC) 2026, hosted by the University of San Jose–Recoletos (USJ-R), which brought together researchers, faculty members, scholars and innovators from various academic institutions to explore the role of innovation, sustainability and interdisciplinary collaboration in developing research-based solutions. Held at the USJ-R Quadricentennial Building, the congress carried the theme, “From Knowledge to Impact: Bridging Innovation, Sustainability, and Community.” Organized by the USJ-R Graduate School through the Center for Policy Research […]...
